item.title: New NFOs watch: Canara Robeco BFS Fund, TRUSTMF Mid Cap Fund open for subscription
item.description: Two mutual fund houses have launched new fund offers (NFOs), targeting sectoral and mid-cap opportunities. Canara Robeco has introduced a Banking and Financial Services Fund, while TRUST Mutual Fund has rolled out a Mid Cap Fund. Both schemes aim to tap India’s structural growth themes with differentiated equity strategies.

item.title: HG Infra Engineering wins Rs 1,582 crore order from NHAI; key details
item.description: Meanwhile, on Friday, HG Infra Engineering shares declined 2.80% to settle at Rs 541.85 on the BSE, slipping from the previous close of Rs 557.45 apiece.

item.title: Who is Nikesh Arora? The Indian-American billionaire hosting a grand Jodhpur wedding for daughter Ayesha, Jack Hughes
item.description: The wedding has become a trending topic on social media, with netizens and news platforms alike sharing glimpses of the extravagant gatherings.

item.title: West Bengal voter list 2026 out today after SIR: Step-by-step guide to check your name before polls
item.description: The Election Commission's release of the West Bengal voter list following the Special Intensive Revision has triggered concerns about exclusions, with over 1.36 crore entries flagged for discrepancies and political parties contesting the process.

item.title: Sebi MF rules: Domestic spot pricing of metals to improve NAV accuracy in gold and silver ETFs, say experts
item.description: Earlier, gold and silver ETFs were valued using LBMA benchmark prices converted into rupees after adjusting for currency movements and import duties. Now, valuations will be based on the polled domestic spot price published by a recognised Indian exchange, currently the MCX.

item.title: Afghanistan-Pakistan conflict: US advises its citizens to leave Pakistan, over 300 Afghan fighters killed
item.description: The US Embassy and Consulates in Pakistan issued an advisory urging citizens to remain vigilant, maintain a low profile, and exercise caution amid heightened military activities.
